subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo — throughput & latency calibration
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo (high QPS / low p95 latency)

Hi Tessa —

We self-signed up on the hosted API last week and ran a couple of exploratory tests, but we're hitting production constraints for our use case and would like to evaluate Redwood Dedicated.

High level: we need a predictable, dedicated GPU pool that can sustain ~200 QPS steady-state for short inference payloads (avg 120 tokens) with a p95 latency target <= 50ms. We'll likely serve a quantized LlamaX 8B variant.

Can we schedule a short call/demo with a focus on:
- throughput sizing and sustained QPS behavior
- latency p95 expectations and tradeoffs (batching / KV cache)
- autoscale/burst options and regional placement (we are based in Singapore)

I copied Tom (infra) — available windows this week: Tue/Thu 10:00–12:00 SGT or Fri 14:00–16:00 SGT.

I've attached a short spreadsheet with sample traffic shape and token distribution (capacity_requirements.xlsx).

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Head of ML Infrastructure
Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: capacity_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai (Priyom Das) <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo (high QPS / low p95 latency)

Hi Claire —

Thanks for signing up and for the spreadsheet — this is exactly the kind of detail that helps us size things correctly. I'm the SDR who will coordinate the intake and setup the demo with our capacity specialists. Quick asks so we can make the session productive:

1) Confirm the model variant (you noted LlamaX 8B quantized — is that the exact artifact or will you bring a containerized model?)
2) Are you planning to use streaming responses or non-streaming (we ask because batching strategies differ)?
3) Do you have a preferred cloud region (we can run Dedicated in Singapore but need lead time for capacity pinning)?

I can propose slots that align with your windows — here are three options converted to SGT and also available on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/tessa/30m
- Tue 10:30 SGT (30m)
- Thu 11:00 SGT (45m) — recommended for technical walkthrough
- Fri 14:30 SGT (30m)

I'll loop in Tessa (AE) and Ben (capacity lead) on the demo. If you want a short pre-check we can run a dedicated throughput probe in staging before the joint session — that'll require a staging model artifact or small test container.

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Development Representative
Redwood Inference

[Calendars/links]

From: Claire Huang <claire@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 23:14:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo (high QPS / low p95 latency)

Hi Priyom / Tessa —

Thanks — quick answers below:
- Model: LlamaX-8b-quant (we will provide a quantized artifact; prefer Redwood to host the artifact in staging for the probe)
- Streaming: no, we will use non-streaming generate calls (single response per request)
- Region: Singapore (APAC) is preferred, but we're flexible if you have closer pinned capacity and lower latency options.

We prefer Thu 11:00 SGT for a deeper walkthrough. Also, a couple of requirements / constraints from procurement:
- We need an estimated monthly compute commitment for budgeting; please include ballpark TCO for a pinned pool vs. autoscale burst model.
- SOC2 evidence / audit logs are required before any artifact exchange (can you send the standard questionnaire?)

Tom and I can jump on Thu 11:00 SGT — please send a calendar invite and any pre-read.

Claire

Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Sep 2025 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo (high QPS / low p95 latency)

Hi Claire / Tom —

Great, Thu 11:00 SGT is on our radar. I've booked a 45-minute slot and attached a short meeting brief so everyone has the agenda and responsibilities (meeting-brief.pdf). Agenda highlight:
- 10m: intro + product fit
- 20m: throughput probe design + staging checklist (Priyom to coordinate probe)
- 10m: procurement + next steps (estimate TCO ranges for pinned vs. burst)
- 5m: action items and timeline

Ben will join to cover capacity pinning and autoscale policies. Two operational notes so the probe is smooth:
- Please provide the quantized artifact or a small containerized test image to our staging registry at least 48 hours before the call. If procurement requires SOC2 before artifact exchange, we can share the SOC2 packet and audit-log export process; see link to standard questionnaire in the HubSpot record.
- For Singapore pinned pools we need a 2-week lead time to reserve GPUs for guaranteed throughput.

Proposed pre-work (if you want the throughput probe before the demo):
- You: upload artifact / provide S3 link and credentials to a temporary staging bucket (we'll share an upload template).
- Us: run a 30-minute sustained probe to validate 200 QPS with p95 targets and share results in a follow-up.

I'll send a calendar invite in SGT and include a Zoom + staging playbook link.

Thanks — looking forward to meeting Thu.

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: meeting-brief.pdf (1 page agenda and pre-reqs)
